statements.headline: Hazardous Weather Outlook
statements.summary: Today and tonight. Showers and thunderstorms are likely this afternoon and evening with scattered instances of storms becoming strong enough to support a low end severe threat. Damaging wind and large hail are the primary risks that will subside by the late evening hours.

details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: Today and tonight. Showers and thunderstorms are likely this afternoon and evening with scattered instances of storms becoming strong enough to support a low end severe threat. Damaging wind and large hail are the primary risks that will subside by the late evening hours.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Sunday through Friday. No hazardous weather is expected at this time.
